_doc: Single source of the decision-support rule, shared by the Spark backtest (ForecastEval.decisions), the API (py/agri/api/decisions.py) and the app (app/js/decision.js). All three are tested against conf/decision_fixtures.json. Costs are fractions of today's price: placeholders for storage, handling and quality loss, NOT measured farm costs; farmers can override them in the app. Precedence: unsupported > forecast_expired > stale report > HOLD > SELL > COMPARE > WATCH, all evaluated on primary_horizon only. COMPARE is not back-tested (no transport data). See docs/MODEL_CARD.md#decision-support.
